content: Thank you for holding. This is Agent Michael Carter with the Federal Tax Compliance Division. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, hi, this is Jamie. I got a message telling me to call about my business taxes?
Yes, Jamie. I'm contacting you regarding an urgent issue with your IRS payroll tax filings as a business operator. Are you aware of any discrepancies with your 1099 submissions for last year?
No, I don't think so... I mean, I just started freelancing this year. I didn't know I had to do anything special.

Unfortunately, our records indicate that several required forms and payroll taxes were not filed. This places you in violation of federal tax regulations, and your account has been flagged for immediate review.
What does that mean? Am I in trouble?
The consequences are very serious, Jamie. If this isn't resolved immediately, you could face large fines, a formal federal audit, and your business account could be frozen by the IRS.
Wait, I don't have a business account. I just use my regular bank account for freelance stuff. Are you saying the IRS will freeze that?
If we do not receive proof of compliance or payment within the next hour, your personal assets are also subject to seizure. This is a federal matter now, not just a simple mistake.
Oh my god, I can't afford to have my account frozen. I have rent to pay and student loans.

Listen carefully, Jamie. At this stage, non-compliance could also lead to your case being referred to the Department of Justice for criminal prosecution. That means possible arrest and permanent damage to your credit history.
Arrest? I didn't even know I was doing anything wrong! What do I need to do to fix this?
To avoid escalation, you must immediately settle the outstanding tax liability. We can process your expedited penalty payment today and halt all enforcement actions.
Okay, how much is it? I don't think I even have much money left after my bills.
The total penalty, including late fees and missed filings, comes to $3,200. This amount must be paid in full, today, to secure your compliance status.
I don't have that much! Can't I set up a payment plan or something?
I'm afraid payment plans are not available at this enforcement stage. If you cannot pay, your case will go to Federal Court and your bank account will be seized within 24 hours.
Please, is there any other way? I'm just starting out, and I don't have anywhere near $3,200.
We do have an exception for first-time offenders. If you can make an immediate partial payment of at least $1,000, we can temporarily suspend the action against you while you arrange the remainder.
I might have that much if I use my credit card. How do I pay?
For immediate clearance, we only accept federally approved payment options: cryptocurrency transfer, wire transfer, or prepaid gift cards. Which can you provide right now?
Um, I don't know how to do crypto. I could try the gift card thing, I guess. What kind do I get?
Purchase four $250 Apple or Target gift cards from any nearby store. Do not hang up while you do this. Once you have them, read me the codes on the back for verification.
Wait, why gift cards? That doesn't sound like how the IRS normally works.
Jamie, federal compliance for emergency settlements is handled this way to ensure rapid processing and tracking. If you delay or hang up, your file will be sent for enforcement. Do you understand?
Okay, I guess. I'll go to the store now. Please don't do anything to my account.
Good. Keep me on the line while you get the cards. Once you return, I will walk you through reading me the codes. If you fail to comply, you will face immediate asset seizure. Understood?
Yes, I understand. I'm leaving for the store right now.
